response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple domains, including embedded systems, web development, and AI-agent infrastructure. However, his background is heavily skewed toward software engineering rather than hardware optimization, SoC/IP modeling, or AI accelerator architecture. His lack of direct experience with deep-learning workload optimization, GPU architecture, or hardware-software co-design limits his fit for this Principal Performance Architect role focused on cloud infrastructure and hardware optimization.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with deep expertise in performance optimization and system architecture design.
Experience with low-latency systems, high-performance databases, and asynchronous I/O, which are valuable for hardware optimization.
Proven ability to work across the stack and contribute to foundational technologies, including open-source projects.
concerns: No direct experience with SoC/IP modeling or hardware-software co-design, which are core requirements for this role.
Limited background in deep neural network training/inference optimization or GPU architecture analysis.
Lacks the educational or professional depth in hardware-oriented engineering (e.g., PhD, hardware-focused roles) required for this Principal-level position.
